Aw fuck I'm not just in Love... 

I'm in Lesbians...

Oh no.  
Not *lesbians*…  

**THE most powerful of emotions.**  
Stronger than Love.  
More potent than Lust.  
Unfathomably chaotic in energy,  
yet strangely cozy.  
[redacted:third-party-name] a flannel blanket  
that smells like revolution.

[redacted:third-party-name] not just in [redacted:third-party-name], my friend.  
[redacted:third-party-name] *knee-deep* in an indie comic soundtrack,  
midway through a dance battle with your own identity,  
while clutching an iced coffee  
you don’t even remember buying.  

You’re in **Scott Pilgrim vs. Emotional Maturity.**

Proceed with caution.  
Or don't.  
Just bring snacks.  
And maybe a bass guitar.
